query:
-- Get all NULL branchId sales transactions ordered by id
-- Assign alternating branches to split the data evenly
UPDATE sales_transactions
SET branchId = CASE 
  WHEN (id % 2) = 0 THEN 20  -- Tema Branch
  ELSE 300012  -- Kasoa Branch
END
WHERE branchId IS NULL;
